title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Business Returns: Points by Class of the Piece Sent Back
content:
Class table for the business restocking charge on a changed-mind return of special-order merchandise bought through Northgate Purchases & Returns on a Northgate Business Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership.

## Class of the piece sent back

When the sale line is in merchandise class major appliance, 3 percentage points are added to the business restocking rate; when it is in class mattress and furniture, 1 point is added; otherwise nothing is added.

The class is the merchandise class recorded on the sale line that the return authorization covers.

| Merchandise class of the sale line | Points added to the business restocking rate |
|---|---|
| major appliance | 3 |
| mattress and furniture | 1 |
| television, general merchandise or any other class | 0 |

## Readings (hypothetical lines)

- A commercial refrigerator recorded as major appliance: 3 points added.
- A conference table recorded as mattress and furniture: 1 point added.
- A wall-mounted television recorded as television: nothing added.
